EXT. KINGDOM - DAY

The camera pans over a bustling medieval kingdom, with knights in shining armor and ladies in flowing gowns hurrying about their daily business. CUT TO:

INT. THRONE ROOM - DAY

ARTHUR
(whispering)
Behold, the mystical realm of... Vapowave!

ARTHUR
(laughing maniacally)
Behold, my subjects! The future is now!

As the camera pans across the kingdom, we see the people going about their daily business, but with a twist. They're all wearing the same, garish outfits, and their faces are distorted by the same, glitchy patterns.

CUT TO:

INT. THRONE ROOM - DAY

The king sits upon his throne, surrounded by his advisors, who are all dressed in the same, futuristic attire. They're all sipping on strange, glowing drinks, and their faces are lit up by the glow of their own personal vaporwave screens.

ARTHUR
(to his advisors)
We must spread this... Vapowave... throughout the land! Make it a way of life!

ADVISOR 2

ARTHUR
(laughing)
